title: tests.py fails its seconds ceiling on a darwin host that sprint workers share, though every test passes
goal: A full tests.py run on a darwin host that several sprint workers queue on exits 0 when all tests pass: the seconds ceiling (darwin 20) is measured on the suite's own run time, not on a wall time that the host's other sessions inflate; seen 2026-10-10 in BG-45zpw2go: 87 passed, 21 s, 32 s and 30 s against 20 s, with six other clones waiting on the host lock and a load average near 4.
notes: SP-lyfnpu37 (2026-10-10): with four headless workers on the host, full tests.py runs took 23-40 s against the 20 s darwin ceiling and exited 1 though every test passed (BG-a3zs7s2y, ST-gdcn5467, ST-agxrnaoo, BG-45zpw2go workers); alone the suite ran 19.1-19.9 s with 93-94 ids, so it sits at the ceiling even unloaded.
